etymology: from an obsolete but more primary form of meiromai (to get as a section or allotment)
avSummary: part 24, portion 3, coast 3, behalf 2, respect 2, misc 9
definition:
1) a part
    1a) a part due or assigned to one
    1b) lot, destiny
 2) one of the constituent parts of a whole
    2a) in part, partly, in a measure, to some degree,
        as respects a part, severally, individually
    2b) any particular, in regard to this, in this respect
